replies.author: Stimulating
replies.body:
Yes exactly. 

My logic is, why use a version that's bad for PvP on a server based around PvP? 
If it was 1.7/1.8 compatible, that's a different story and allows users on both sides to get what they want. 

Don't get me wrong, I really appreciate the work and the job done, I just really don't like 1.8 and don't see the point of kicking a fair amount of the playerbase in the ass. 
Though the update is really well done, a lot of the community has asked for the server to not be only 1.8 compatible because 1.8 is laggier for most people and for the other reason previously mentioned. 

TL;DR

Overall, I think the update is superb and I thank all of the staff greatly for the effort put in, it just has issues surrounding versions.
